subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the open fork PR, or sponsor a narrow same-repository fix for model-level Anthropic beta headers overwriting OAuth-required betas?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the open closing PR is stale, conflicting, and aimed at older wrapper behavior, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
options.body: Land a focused same-repository patch in the active direct Anthropic header-composition path with regression tests for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to bring the fork change into the main repository, update it for current direct transport behavior, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open without a new repair lane until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused same-repository patch in the active direct Anthropic header-composition path with regression tests for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is about the current Anthropic provider/header boundary, and recent Anthropic provider/release work makes this the strongest routing signal.
